player_prompt.intro:
U na le Player {player_id} ho tsoa Connect Four.
Sembolo sa diski sa hao: {symbol}.
Boro di na le {num_rows} dintho le {num_cols} kolone.
Baeti ba etela pele ba arola diski ba bahae koloneng (0 ho ea pele {end_col}).
Ea nang le pele eo a tsamaea (a hae) diski nne ka tsela e vertikali, horisontali, kapa diagonali a kenya.
Ka tsatsi la hao, ngola nomoro ya kolone ka tšōana ho etsa hatsoe ha hao.
Ejemple: '[col 4]' kapa '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Boto ea papali ha e bonahale ho libapali.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Mofuta wa hatsoe ha o lumellane. Mofuta o hlokang: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Invalid action. Column {col} is out of bounds.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Hatsoe e seng wona. Kolone {col} e phunyeletse.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} o arola diski sa hae ({player_symbol}) koloneng {col}.

outcome.win: Sebapali {player_id} se hlōla ka ho kopanya tse 'nè!
outcome.draw: Papali e ile ea fela ho se na letho le etsahetseng.
